subject: riotInterceptor
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: corporate riot-control interceptor with a water cannon and neon light bars.
Style: Cyberpunk 2077.
reasoning:
I'm planning a single TypeScript module for a static armored van model, around 5.2m long and 2.2m wide, using simple part-building APIs like b.part and basic geometries to keep the design confident and manageable.

I'm sketching out the vehicle's details: four big wheels, a lower hull, cab, roof-mounted water cannon turret, glowing light bars, bumper, headlights, decals, antenna, and a rear tank with hose, along with a color palette of gunmetal, magenta, cyan, and warning yellow, then working through coordinates for the hull, cab, and windshield placement.

Working out the hood slope and windshield tilt now, figuring out the rotation math so the top of the windshield leans back correctly toward the rear of the cab.

Now I'm adding a water cannon turret on the cab roof, positioning the swivel base and barrel cylinder with an upward tilt so the nozzle aims forward and slightly up, plus starting a light bar across the roof front.

Still blocking out exterior details... headlights, grille, push bar with yellow/black stripes, side neon strips, underglow, and dark window slits. I'm also planning a corp emblem texture plane on the doors using a simple circle-and-chevron logo, applying it as a glowing texture on both side panels.

Now I'm positioning the wheels across three axles, sizing fender arches, and planning roof-mounted gear like an antenna and a rear-lying cylindrical tank with a glowing cyan water-level strip and bands, keeping overall height capped around 3.2 units.
